comment: Every output block the manuscript prints for a goldened figure must be what the program prints. Covers chapters past Part I whose figures are standalone bins — ch35 today. Those figures run in the examples suite against goldens, which proves the program still prints what was blessed; nothing proved the book still quotes it. custom/book-listings compares code only, and verify-transcripts.sh matches simulator lines shaped '12.34ns INFO ...', so a hand-edited println! output block in the manuscript drifted silently between them. Mutation-checked in both directions: editing the chapter fails it, editing a golden fails it. No simulator, no cargo.
